scenarios.name: Inspect Sketch commands outside sketch edit

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/revolve/revolve-profile.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the user selects the Sketch ribbon tab
Line, Circle, Arc, Rectangle, Fillet, Text and Point are enabled in Create
